arguments.question: Assess the 21/63-session macro and policy transmission channels for ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA using the registered Fed/rates sources and fixed SPY/IWM/HYG context. Distinguish documented facts from inferences; identify whether rates, liquidity, growth, or credit conditions are material common drivers. Stopping criterion: use registered macro sources only; state any unavailable releases rather than expanding discovery.
arguments.decision_impact: Could change whether near-term theses are primarily company-specific or dominated by shared macro valuation and demand sensitivity.
